description: Only what varies per run and is NOT a FORMULATION.md-governed value. This is the entire content of runs.config_json (see storage.create_run and storage_types.RunRecord.config) -- it deliberately does not duplicate AcquisitionConfig/EnrichmentParams/AnalysisParams, which are reconstructable from parameters_version plus the git-tracked config/parameters.toml.
docstring:
Per-run pipeline options, never a formulation parameter.

Attributes:
    start_stage: Which stage to begin at. ACQUISITION for a fresh run; set to a later stage by resume_run (first non-succeeded stage) or by a deliberate stage re-run after a parameter change.
    max_catalog_pages: Smoke-test limiter forwarded to acquisition.fetch_steamspy_catalog(max_pages=...). None means no limit.
    request_budget_override: Overrides AcquisitionConfig.request_budget for this run only when set; None defers to the configured default.
    notes: Free user text, persisted to runs.notes verbatim (also duplicated into config_json for convenience, since config_json is the single JSON blob the UI reads back for the 'Run New Analysis' form's remembered values).

to_dict / from_dict: Round-trip through runs.config_json. from_dict must accept a dict missing newer fields (loading an older run after a code change) by falling back to each field's own default rather than raising.
preconditions: max_catalog_pages, if not None, is a positive int
request_budget_override, if not None, is a positive int
postconditions: PipelineConfig.from_dict(cfg.to_dict()) == cfg for every valid cfg
from_dict tolerates a dict from an older schema version missing newer fields, filling in defaults rather than raising KeyError

edge_cases.input: from_dict({}) (empty dict, e.g. a run created before a new field existed)
edge_cases.expected_behavior: returns PipelineConfig() with all defaults, no exception

edge_cases.input: from_dict with an unknown extra key (a future field read by older code)
edge_cases.expected_behavior: the unknown key is ignored, not an error -- forward compatibility in the other direction

edge_cases.input: start_stage stored as the plain string 'enrichment' rather than a PipelineStage instance (round-tripped through JSON, which has no enum type)
edge_cases.expected_behavior: from_dict converts it back to PipelineStage.ENRICHMENT; to_dict emits the plain string value, never the enum repr

not a valid 'no limit' spelling (that is None) and not a valid positive limit either -- treated as invalid; the caller should omit the field or pass a positive int, but PipelineConfig itself does not raise since it is a plain dataclass with no __post_init__ validation, so this is caught by whichever validation layer constructs it from a UI form, not by this type

unit_tests.name: test_roundtrip_default_values
unit_tests.description: A default-constructed PipelineConfig survives to_dict/from_dict unchanged.

unit_tests.name: test_roundtrip_all_fields_set
unit_tests.description: A fully populated PipelineConfig survives the round trip.

unit_tests.name: test_from_dict_ignores_unknown_keys
unit_tests.description: An extra unrecognized key does not raise.

unit_tests.name: test_start_stage_json_string_roundtrip
unit_tests.description: start_stage survives a real json.dumps/json.loads round trip through to_dict/from_dict, not just direct dict passing.
unit_tests.expected: PipelineStage.ANALYSIS preserved through json.dumps(cfg.to_dict()) then json.loads then from_dict
